main_text.p: 171. Ebn Hamdun ] بن حمدون author libri تذكرة [?] qui variæ materiæ analecta continet.

176. نشق الازهار ] q. d. Odoratus florum. liber historicus & geographicus, authore, ابو عبد الله محمد بن احمد [?] Abu Abdollah Mohammed Ebn Ahmed, à quo ad umbilicum perductus est, anno H. 922. titulus integer est نشق الازهار في عجايب الاقطار [?].
175. Sharhol Mawakef ] i. e. Explicatio libri dicti Al-Mawakef, q.d. Stationes, qui doctrinæ Scholasticæ compendium est. utriusque author in exemplari quo usus sum, Anonymus.
179. Kadi Shahaboddinus ] القاضي شهاب الدين بن ابي الدم الحموي AlKadi Shehaboddin Ebn Abil Dam, AlHamawi historicus. AbulFed.
p. 187. Asphahaniensis ] الاصفهاني Al-Asphahani, ita vulgò audit qui AlBidawii librum de fundamentis Theologiæ Scholasticæ quem الطوالع vocat, Scholiis illustravit.
Ep. Nawayi ] Epistola seu tractatiuncula quædam, à محي الدين يحيي النواوي المعروف بالنواوي [?] Mohaiddin Yahya qui AlNawawi appellatur, exarata.

192. R. Judas Levita author libri Cozari ] ר׳ יהודה הלוי R. Judah Hallevi, qui librum suum הכוזרי HacCozari inscripsit, quòd dialogum sc. inter Cozarorum regem & doctum quendam Judæum R. Isaacum contineat. Num autem talis unquam extiterit rex, dubitare videtur author Meor Einaim; quod tamen mihi satis probabile fit, cum legamus in Geographia Sharifol Edrisi apud Cozaros liberum fuisse unicuique quam vellet religionem amplecti, atque apud Ahmedem e. 42. R. David. G.nz.

page.notes: The Arabic and Hebrew script is copied as best read from the scan; the Arabic lines are uncertain in places and are marked [?]. The word "perductus" in the entry for Odoratus florum is partly obscured and is copied with [?]. The printed "Al-Mawakef", "Nawayi" and the Arabic of the last Hebrew/Arabic entries are doubtful. The line "Josephi" is set right-aligned and is taken as a separate line. The left-margin numbers are the entry numbers of the column and are given as notes.
